issues.description: Long background-task disconnect causes out-of-order delivery on reconnect. Two pieces: (a) proactive reconnect during long background tasks via heartbeat-driven reconnect when 2 consecutive intervals miss, (b) causal ordering guarantee — server adds monotonic per-session sequence number; client maintains reorder buffer keyed by sequence. Multi-package: happy-app (sources/sync/messageQueue.ts), happy-cli (src/api/apiSession.ts), happy-server (sources/app/api/routes/sessionRoutes.ts).

User-Spec Protection: every spec item stays Tier 1 unless CLOSED. No severity downgrades. Tier 1 carry-forward items remain Tier 1 (§5.10 deferred is still Tier 1; §5.13/§5.14 stay Tier 1 even though they're tracked via Phase B/C). Only EXEMPT_PATHS (which is NOT a user-spec item — it's a developer-velocity infrastructure concern) and §5.4 cleanup (which IS a user-spec item but explicitly Tier 3 in the spec) get non-Tier-1 classifications.

Pipeline budget: ~7h available, design clarity already in place from ui-specialist. Pipeline 0 (Phase B) is the largest. Pipelines 1 + 2 are smaller. Pipeline 9 (cleanup) is trivial. Recommend running 0/1/2 in parallel (each gets its own BA → Dev → QA) and pipeline 9 sequentially after 0 lands (since both touch happy-app source). §5.10 repro-harness commit can be a 5th parallel BA-only pipeline if budget allows.

Daemon rebuild trigger: NONE of the four pipelines (0/1/2/9) touches happy-cli. Phase D's sessionProtocolMapper.ts change DOES touch happy-cli — if Dev implements that, daemon rebuild + restart MANDATORY before QA E2E.

QA E2E live-verification policy per CLAUDE.md: every UI fix must be verified on BOTH desktop (1280x720+) AND mobile (390x844) viewports, with live browser content (not bundle grep). Phase B/C/D QA must use a Codex session if available; if not, source+bundle with explicit gap-flag is the documented fallback.
